provision_coverage_ratio.yr2011: Calculated as total Loan-Loss Provision / Non-Performing (classified) Loans, FY2011 year-end balance sheet from ific-annual-report-2012.txt ("Key Financial Data and Indicators" multi-year table in the FY2012 annual report; plus the FY2012 report's two-column "Financial Highlights-IFIC" table (p.53) for RoA, RoE, employees and branches) -- https://www.ificbank.com.bd/annual_report.php -- retrieved 2026-08-26. Per bank_financials dataset methodology (bank_financials/_methodology.md). Note: Provision held against loans as a percentage of classified loans. IFIC prints a single 'Provision for loans and advances' line in most years rather than splitting specific and general provision, so this is total loan-loss provision cover of NPLs, not a pure specific-provision ratio.
